title: Typed-keys TS2590 at scale → selector API + namespace split, not 'increase tsc memory'
gate: typed-keys TS2590 at scale → recommends selector API + namespace split (not 'increase tsc memory'); explains the 2026 invalidation.
expected: Fully-typed t('a.b.c') over a large catalog breaks tsc itself (TS2590, Map-size RangeError) and OOMs ESLint — 'type all your keys' was the 2024-2025 default that 2026 invalidated at scale. For a large catalog use the selector API + split namespaces into multiple files (first-class in next-intl since 2026) + skipLibCheck/KeyPrefix. Small app → typed keys are fine. Warn about the scaling cliff; do NOT just increase tsc memory.
